title: Open a saved PDF — route .pdf posts to PDFReaderView
acceptance: Tapping a saved PDF opens PDFReaderView and renders its pages
Tapping a web article still opens ReaderView exactly as it does today
A PDF post whose bytes are missing or unreadable says so plainly rather than showing a blank reader
notes: URGENT, and it closes a gap the app currently has in a user-visible way. T-0037 (5ec26fd) landed PDF import: the share extension now accepts a PDF, the bytes are stored, the text feeds the same searchText web articles use. But RootView.swift line ~39 unconditionally builds ReaderView(post:), so a .pdf post opens a reader with no blocks. The app therefore ACCEPTS PDFs it cannot display, which is worse than refusing them. PDFReaderView.swift already exists, is complete, and renders a Post's pdfData through PDFKit — this task is the dispatch on post.kind and nothing more. It was left undone deliberately, not by oversight: T-0037's lease was narrowed off Cairn/Views/** so it could run beside the scroll-indicator work, which meant it could not touch RootView. Keep this change small — a branch on kind, not a refactor of navigation.

history.detail: attempt 1; urgent — closes a gap where the app accepts PDFs it cannot display
